0022600169.text: The Denver Nuggets (2-2, 9th in the West and 1.5 games behind for 4th in the Northwest) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, 5th in the West and 0.5 games behind for 2nd in the Northwest). Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 137-132 home win over Portland on April 6, 2026.
